_README: Fantasy Premier League standings for the Philly Blues site.
This file is written automatically by scripts/update_fantasy.py, run on a
schedule by .github/workflows/update-fantasy.yml. You should not need to
edit it by hand — but if you do, keep it valid JSON (mind the commas).
leagueName / leagueId / inviteUrl / totalManagers: identity of the league.
gameweek: the last completed gameweek these standings reflect. null before the season starts.
updated: ISO date the file was last written by the script.
standings: top 10, in order. Empty [] before any gameweek has finished —
the page then shows its pre-season 'season starts GW1' state.
Each standing: pos (rank), manager (person), team (FPL team name),
gw (that gameweek's points), total (season total points).
